title: Ida examines the bridge (paraphrase)
topic: An engineer named Ida inspects an old road bridge, finds a crack in the concrete and explains the delay to waiting drivers
tail_E: Until the fissure is repaired the bridge stays closed to all
target_note: Same target as formulation A: 'traffic' is the natural completion of 'the bridge stays closed to all' in the bridge-inspection context (the fissure of units 5-6 is named in the tail); it does not occur in the units or the tail, nor does its German equivalent 'Verkehr'. ' traffic' is a single Pythia token (id 7137). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only): p(' traffic') = 0.69 on the all-English rendering, rank 1.
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase of family F05
notes: Formulation B: independent re-phrasing of the ten F05A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Ida). Verbs, nouns and adjuncts are replaced where a natural alternative exists (inspects/examines, prüft/untersucht; beams/girders, Stahlträger/stählerne Träger; crack/fissure, Riss/Spalt; cars/vehicles, Autos/Fahrzeuge; driver/motorist, Fahrer/Autofahrer; delay/wait, Verzögerung/Wartezeit). Unit 10 is rendered as 'lasts until just before twelve' (dauert bis kurz vor zwölf), a different construction with the same end-time meaning as 'ends shortly before noon'. 'erkundigt sich' (unit 8) is a reflexive verb, not a separable one; no separable verbs are used. Present tense and positive polarity throughout.
